Exercise A

Listening: First Day at the Café

You will hear each recording twice, just like in the real MSA exam. Listen carefully, then answer the questions below — you won't be able to play a recording more than twice.

Part 1 — Manager's Briefing
Part 1 — Comprehension Questions

1 What time does the shadowing period start?

2 What is not allowed in the kitchen?

3 How long is the break?

4 How should staff report being late?

5 When is payday?

Part 2 — Dialogue: Two Coworkers
Part 2 — Comprehension Questions

6 What should Jake learn before his first shift?

7 What discount do staff get?

8 Who makes the final decision about shifts?

Exercise B

Reading: Job Ads & Workplace Notices

Read the texts below, then answer the questions — just like Reading Parts 1 and 2 in the real MSA exam.

Part 1 — Match the Applicant to the Job

Barista Wanted: Make coffee and chat with regular customers. Friendly personality essential — you'll be at the counter all shift.

Kitchen Porter Wanted: Wash dishes and keep the kitchen clean. Quiet, behind-the-scenes role — little contact with customers.

Waiter/Waitress Wanted: Take orders, carry plates, and serve tables. Good memory and a calm attitude under pressure needed.

Delivery Cyclist Wanted: Deliver orders around town by bike. Must enjoy being outdoors in all weather.

1 Aisha loves talking to people and making drinks. She should apply for the role.

2 Noah is shy and prefers working alone, away from customers. He should apply for the role.

3 Leon has a great memory and stays calm even when it's busy. He should apply for the role.

4 Mia loves being outside and cycling, whatever the weather. She should apply for the role.

Part 2 — Workplace Notices: True or False?

🧼 Staff must wash their hands at least every thirty minutes during a shift.

📵 Phones are not allowed on the shop floor, but may be used in the staff room.

🍽️ Free staff meals are provided for anyone working a shift longer than six hours.

👕 The dress code is all black clothing, with closed-toe shoes.

5 Staff never need to wash their hands during a shift.

6 Phones may be used in the staff room.

7 Every staff member gets a free meal on every shift, no matter how short.

8 Open-toe shoes are allowed under the dress code.

Exercise C

Writing: Blog Post

Choose ONE of the two prompts below and write 80–100 words, just like Writing Part 3 in the real MSA exam. This section is graded by your teacher, not automatically.

Choose ONE prompt

Prompt 1: Describe your first day at a new weekend job. What did you learn, and how did you feel?

Prompt 2: Imagine you are writing to a friend about a job you would love to try. Explain why it would suit you.
